_note: Course-number equivalences for prerequisite checks. A retired course number that the registrar still lists as a prerequisite is satisfied by completing any course in `accepts`. Approved by the project owner on 2026-11-14; status keeps how well each is supported. Scope: an equivalence with `scope_programs`/per-course `programs` applies only to those programs. Nothing here changes the board or the catalog.
